title.zh: 用 SQL 写一张汇总表
title.en: Build a Summary Table with SQL

brief.zh: 把温度记录按区域压成短表，再把优先检查的区域排在前面。
brief.en: Condense temperature logs into an area summary, then sort to see where to check first.

concept.zh: GROUP BY 把同一类放在一起，COUNT(reading) 和 AVG(reading) 各给一份汇总。
concept.en: GROUP BY puts like rows together. COUNT(reading) and AVG(reading) summarize each group.

body.zh: 先找出要汇总的记录，再用 GROUP BY zone 按区域分组。COUNT(reading) 数的是组内有读数的行，AVG(reading) 算的是这些读数的平均值。
body.en: Select the rows to summarize, then use GROUP BY zone to form area groups. COUNT(reading) counts rows with a reading, and AVG(reading) averages those readings.

body.zh: WHERE 在分组前筛选单条读数。想在算出每组平均值后，留下均值至少 25°C 的区域，就用 HAVING AVG(reading) >= 25。
body.en: WHERE filters individual readings before grouping. To keep areas that average at least 25°C after grouping, use HAVING AVG(reading) >= 25.

body.zh: 给平均值取名 mean，再用 ORDER BY mean DESC 把保留下来的区域按平均温度从高到低排。
body.en: Name the average mean, then use ORDER BY mean DESC to put the remaining areas in highest-to-lowest mean order.

caption.zh: 输入表有三条读数。机库占两条，车间占一条。
caption.en: The input table has three readings. Two are from the hangar and one is from the workshop.

caption.zh: GROUP BY zone 把机库的 18°C 和 24°C 放成一组。
caption.en: GROUP BY zone puts the hangar's 18°C and 24°C readings together.

caption.zh: COUNT(reading) 和 AVG(reading) 给每组一份结果。按平均温度降序后，车间在前。
caption.en: COUNT(reading) and AVG(reading) summarize each group. Sorting by average descending puts the workshop first.

caption.zh: 再设置 HAVING AVG(reading) >= 25，只有车间组通过门槛。
caption.en: Add HAVING AVG(reading) >= 25. Only the workshop group meets the cutoff.

prompt.zh: 如果保留两个区域，再按样本数从多到少排，哪个区域在前？
prompt.en: If you keep both areas and sort by reading count from highest to lowest, which area comes first?

options.en: Both areas merge into one row

feedback.zh: 机库有两条，车间有一条。改变排序依据只改变汇总行的顺序。
feedback.en: The hangar has two readings and the workshop has one. Changing the sort key only changes the summary order.
